train_simclr_model: train a SimCLR self-supervised model on a dataset with NT-Xent loss and cosine annealing
create_specialized_l2_regularizer: create a custom L2 regularizer autograd function that normalizes embeddings by magnitude only
review_simclr_trainer_step: review the SimCLRTrainer _step method that computes loss on augmented view pairs
save_simclr_checkpoint: save a SimCLR model checkpoint with network state dict and optimizer state to disk
refactor_simclr_gradient_combination: refactor the SimCLRTrainer to use layer-wise gradient combination with configurable margin ratios
